In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
L‐arginine, a NO precursor, is a pro‐metastatic factor, while L‐NAME is an anti‐metastatic one.
L‐NAME alone increases metastasis by decreasing the diameter of arteriolar and venous vessels, while L‐arginine alone suppresses metastasis by inhibiting endogenous NO production.
